input: Get the piano tuned before the holidays

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The specific holiday deadline determines the urgency of the booking and how much lead time is available to find a tuner.
The type and condition of the piano (e.g. upright vs. grand, last tuned 1 year ago vs. 10 years ago) affects the complexity, duration, and cost of the tuning job.
Knowing whether a preferred or previously used tuner exists changes the first action — re-booking a known contact vs. searching for someone new.
The location of the piano determines where the tuner must travel and may affect availability, travel fees, or scheduling windows.
The user may want only a standard tuning, or may also need repairs, voicing, or regulation — this changes cost and appointment length.
Understanding the purpose (casual holiday gathering, a child's recital, a performance) sets the quality bar and whether concert-pitch precision matters.
Budget awareness affects which tuner tier to target and whether cost is a deciding factor when comparing options.

gold.taskTitle: Get the piano tuned before the holidays
gold.taskDescription: Arrange and complete a professional piano tuning session in time for an upcoming holiday period.

questions.title: Which holiday are you trying to beat the deadline for?
questions.description: Identifies the hard deadline so urgency and lead time can be calculated.

questions.title: What type of piano is it, and when was it last tuned?
questions.description: Determines the complexity of the job — upright vs. grand, and whether a pitch raise may be needed on top of a standard tuning.

questions.title: Do you already have a piano tuner you have used before?
questions.description: Establishes whether the first step is a simple re-booking or a fresh search for a qualified technician.

questions.title: What city or area is the piano located in?
questions.description: Pinpoints the geographic area to scope tuner availability and any travel-fee considerations.

questions.title: Do you need anything beyond a standard tuning, such as repairs or voicing?
questions.description: Clarifies whether additional services are needed, which would require a longer appointment or a specialist.

questions.title: What will the piano mainly be used for over the holidays?
questions.description: Reveals the quality bar required — casual background playing versus a performance or recital demands a higher standard of precision.

questions.title: Do you have a budget in mind for the tuning service?
questions.description: Determines whether cost is a filtering factor when selecting between tuner options.
